Container.Name: chowkidar
Container.Overview: Lightweight Docker health monitor with auto-heal actions and multi-provider notifications. Watches container health events and reacts with configurable actions (restart, stop, run-script, webhook, auto-heal). Supports Discord, Slack, Telegram, ntfy, Gotify, Pushover, email, and plain Apprise URLs.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Chowkidar web interface. Open this port in your browser to access the dashboard.

Config.Name: Config Path
Config.Description: Directory where Chowkidar stores its config file, SQLite database, and logs. Must be a persistent path — data will be lost on container removal if not mapped.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Docker socket used to monitor containers and perform actions (restart, stop, etc.). Required — do not change unless you are using a Docker socket proxy.

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: Encryption key used to protect notification credentials (webhook URLs, passwords, tokens) stored on disk. Set this to a long random string (e.g. 32+ characters). If left empty, secrets are stored as plaintext. Once set, do not change this value or your saved credentials will become unreadable.

Config.Name: Container Name Filter
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of container names to watch. Leave empty to monitor all containers. Example: sonarr,radarr,plex

Config.Name: Container Label Filter
Config.Description: Watch only containers that have this Docker label set. Leave empty to monitor all containers. Example: chowkidar.enable=true

Config.Name: Docker Host
Config.Description: Override the Docker host endpoint. Leave empty to use the mapped Docker socket. Set this if you are using a Docker socket proxy (e.g. tcp://socket-proxy:2375).

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Controls how much detail is written to the log. Options: debug (most verbose, useful for troubleshooting), info (normal operation), warn (warnings only), error (errors only). Default: info.
